subject.title: Add an official Featherless AI provider plugin

question: Should OpenClaw accept Featherless AI as an official external provider package now, after live API proof and release-package review, or should Featherless remain a generic custom-provider/ClawHub-only path for now?
rationale: This adds official provider/package/release surface and new auth/setup options, so correctness alone does not decide whether OpenClaw should own and publish it.

options.title: Continue With Linked PR
options.body: Proceed with the linked draft PR once live Featherless proof, package metadata, and release ownership are confirmed.

options.title: Keep Generic For Now
options.body: Leave users on generic custom-provider configuration and close or park the official package work until demand or ownership is clearer.

options.title: ClawHub-First Package
options.body: Ask for the provider to be published and proven as a ClawHub/npm plugin first, then consider official promotion later.

recommendation.title: Continue With Linked PR
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked draft PR once live Featherless proof, package metadata, and release ownership are confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns this issue, the linked implementation PR, and the recent analogous official-provider addition.
